adoration.text: Daily 08:00–20:00. Tamil bulletin page indicates closed public holidays; homepage does not clarify this exception.

confession.text: 30 minutes before each Mass with effect from 3 October 2026. Bulletin’s older schedule says 15 minutes before weekend Masses.

devotions.text: Rosary Monday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday 11:45; Divine Mercy Tuesday 11:45.
Our Lady of Good Health (Vailankkani), English, Saturdays 17:30 from 3 October 2026. Previous bulletin time 16:00.

office_hours.text: Monday–Friday 10:00–18:00; Saturday 14:00–20:00; Sunday 09:00–14:00. Closed public holidays.

good_to_know.text: Cover knees and shoulders; no shorts, short skirts/dresses, hats/caps in Main Church. Ripped/see-through clothing discouraged; offensive tattoos/symbols should not be visible.
No food/drink or laser pointers in Main Church. Keep phones silent. Lost items: approach Parish Office or email colol.secretariat@catholic.org.sg.
Bookshop between Parish Office and Adoration Room, Saturday 16:00–19:30, Sunday 08:30–14:00; closed public holidays.

public_holidays.text: Monday–Friday public holidays: English 09:00; Tamil 10:00. Office closed; main entrance gates close at 17:00.

events.title: Tamil Divine Mercy devotion
events.text: Poster shows reflection 19:45 and Divine Mercy chaplet 20:15. First and third Fridays indicated; Tamil-only details should be checked with parish.

events.title: New weekend Mass and devotion schedule begins
events.text: English Saturday 16:00/18:30; Sunday 07:30/11:30. Tamil Sunday 09:30/18:30 unchanged. Confession 30 minutes before each Mass; Saturday Vailankkani devotion 17:30.

sacraments.text: Obtain application from Parish Office and submit at least two weeks before baptism with child’s birth certificate, godparents’ baptism/confirmation certificates and parents’ marriage certificate. At least one parent baptised/practising Catholic; up to two official godparents, practising Catholics over 16. Email completed form to reserve date.

2026/7 poster: Tuesdays 19:30–21:00 from 30 June. Sign up through Parish Office. Inquirers and Catholic sponsors welcomed; application forms available. Older 2025/6 poster on dedicated page gives different end time.
Arrange with any priest or Parish Office. Hospitals under parish care: KK Women and Children Hospital, Farrer Park Hospital, Raffles Hospital.
Help with funeral Mass readings, hymns and liturgy; wake prayers and hospitality; follow-up grief support and memorial liturgy invitations on request.

ministries.name: Ministry membership
ministries.text: Catechism, hospitality, Eucharistic ministers, lectors/commentators, music, altar servers, SVDP, Legion of Mary, migrant welfare, legal aid, bereavement and RCIA. Download membership form and email colol.secretariat@catholic.org.sg.

other.text: Meeting room, wake venue and hall bookings: colol.mtn@catholic.org.sg.
From 12 September, Mass intentions are posted on a bulletin board rather than read at Mass. Submit at least two weeks ahead; same-day intentions not accepted.
